source: Ownership and the cap table (see the GDD, 'Ownership and the cap table'). All numbers are proposed and tunable. 'shares' is the capital of a garage at founding. 'valuation' is the formula for what a garage is worth. 'computerGarages' says how the starting world's garages are owned: 'familyShare' of them belong to their founder and family, 'investorShare' have an outside investor, and the rest are held in part by a sponsor or a manufacturer. Stakes are shares of the garage, as a range.
